title: Everyday Savings Account
text: The Meridian Everyday Savings Account pays 4.10% annual profit, calculated daily and credited monthly. Minimum opening balance is PKR 1,000. No monthly maintenance fee. Withdrawals are unlimited through the app and Meridian ATMs. Rates are reviewed quarterly and current rates always appear in the app under Accounts, then Rates.

title: Current Account
text: The Meridian Current Account is a non-profit-bearing checking account for daily transactions. No minimum balance requirement. Includes a free debit card, free internal transfers, and 5 free interbank (IBFT) transfers per month; additional IBFT transfers cost PKR 20 each. A physical chequebook of 25 leaves costs PKR 400.

title: Horizon Credit Card
text: The Meridian Horizon Credit Card has an annual fee of PKR 5,000, waived in the first year and waived in later years when annual spend exceeds PKR 600,000. It earns 1.5 reward points per PKR 100 spent. The monthly service charge on carried balances is 3.3%. Minimum monthly payment is 5% of the outstanding balance or PKR 1,500, whichever is higher.

title: Credit Card Eligibility
text: Horizon Credit Card applicants must be 21 to 65 years old with a minimum verifiable monthly income of PKR 60,000 for salaried individuals or PKR 100,000 for self-employed individuals. Required documents: CNIC, latest salary slip or 6-month bank statement, and proof of employment or business. Approval decisions are typically issued within 5 working days.

title: Personal Loan
text: Meridian Personal Loans range from PKR 100,000 to PKR 3,000,000 with tenures of 12 to 60 months. Pricing is 1-year KIBOR plus a spread of 6% to 9% depending on credit profile. A processing fee of 2% of the loan amount applies, deducted at disbursement. Early settlement is allowed after 12 months with a 3% fee on the remaining principal.

title: Personal Loan Eligibility
text: Personal Loan applicants must be salaried employees with at least 2 years of total work experience and 6 months with the current employer, and a minimum net monthly salary of PKR 50,000. The total monthly installment across all borrower obligations may not exceed 40% of net monthly income. Self-employed applicants are assessed case by case with 2 years of business financials.

title: Fees and Charges Schedule
text: Key Meridian service charges: ATM cash withdrawal at Meridian machines is free; at other banks' ATMs it is PKR 23.44 per withdrawal. Duplicate account statement costs PKR 50 per page at a branch and is free in the app. SMS transaction alerts cost PKR 100 per month; email alerts are free. International debit card transactions carry a 4% foreign transaction fee. A full schedule of charges is published every 6 months.

title: How to Open an Account
text: New customers can open a Meridian account fully digitally in about 10 minutes: download the Meridian app, choose an account type, scan your CNIC, complete a live selfie verification, and fund the account with any amount from PKR 0 to start. Biometric verification against NADRA is performed during onboarding. Accounts are usually active immediately; some applications go to manual review for up to 1 working day.

title: Card Security and Disputes
text: Lost or stolen cards can be frozen instantly in the app under Cards, then Freeze, or by calling the 24-hour helpline at 111-000-000. Unauthorized transactions must be reported within 48 hours of the SMS alert. Dispute resolution for card transactions takes up to 45 days under scheme rules; provisional credit may be issued for confirmed fraud cases. Never share your OTP; Meridian staff will never ask for it.
